verdict.rationale: Missive publishes a REST API alongside webhooks and custom channels explicitly for developer-driven automation (missive-docs-15, missive-docs-31, missive-docs-39), and this is corroborated by a documented, live MCP server (mcp.missiveapp.com) that lets external AI/agent clients read/write conversations, drafts, and calendars (missive-probe-4, missive-probe-rt-1, missive-probe-rt-2). However, probes for a standard OpenAPI/swagger spec at common paths all 404'd, so the REST API's documentation depth/discoverability isn't independently confirmed. Missing for 10: a verified OpenAPI/reference spec or hands-on developer report showing the REST API in actual third-party use.
